build_autovlm_engine: build AutoInlineVlmEngineOptions to auto-select the best local VLM inference engine based on platform and hardware
build_transformers_vlm: build TransformersVlmEngineOptions to configure HuggingFace Transformers with 8-bit quantization and KV cache
build_mlx_vlm_engine: build MlxVlmEngineOptions to configure Apple MLX inference engine for vision-language models on Apple Silicon
build_vllm_engine: build VllmVlmEngineOptions to configure vLLM with tensor parallelism, GPU memory utilization, and CUDA graph mode
build_api_vlm_engine: build ApiVlmEngineOptions to configure API-based VLM service with URL, headers, timeout, and concurrency settings
